title: Verifying an Alien Dictionary
goal: Check dictionary order in a supplied alphabet.
strategy: Only the first differing character decides a pair. If there is none, a longer word cannot precede its own prefix.

phasePurposes.start: Check dictionary order in a supplied alphabet.
phasePurposes.inspect: Only the first differing character decides a pair. If there is none, a longer word cannot precede its own prefix.

phasePurposes.done: Check dictionary order in a supplied alphabet.

edgeCases: Longer shared prefix is invalid first
